text:
A ray of light in water is incident on the surface. The angle of incidence is much smaller than the
critical angle.
air
water
ray of light
What happens to this ray?
A
It is completely reflected.
B
It is completely refracted.
C
It is partially reflected and partially refracted.
D
It is refracted at an angle of refraction of 90°.

options.label: C
options.text: It is partially reflected and partially refracted.

options.label: D
options.text: It is refracted at an angle of refraction of 90°.
